audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze and labelled the lane TRICKY 7/10. The content layer and the packet levelChart both read Lissandra on all seven rows, and the win rate is 52.89% over 1681 games.
audit.why: Ryze has no dash and no blink anywhere in his kit; Lissandra's root is point-and-click-reliable against him and her ultimate is a hard stun he cannot answer. Every row disagreed across layers, which is the exact failure the chart rule exists to prevent.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides to Lissandra with the whys rewritten where they argued a neutral or losing case, and diff moved to FAVOURED 4.5/10 with the matching tone.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic anti-assassin template. Ryze is neither an assassin nor a diver, so it said nothing about this lane's level 6.
audit.why: What changes at 6 is that Frozen Tomb is point-and-click on a champion with zero mobility, and Realm Warp does not save him from a stun that lands instantly.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the immobility and the Realm Warp interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the page never names any Ryze ability and carries zero sequencing advice, and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Worse, the page treats Rune Prison as a root unconditionally.
audit.why: Rune Prison only ROOTS if the target already has Flux on them; without Flux it is a slow. That makes Spell Flux (E, 3.5s down to 2.5s) the actual tell — the orb, not the cage, is what tells you a root is coming. Overload is 5s but every other spell resets it, and Realm Warp is 180s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Named Rune Prison, Spell Flux, Overload and Realm Warp with real cooldowns, and stated the Flux prerequisite as the thing to watch.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' after a wasted Rune Prison.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Fifteen is not a rank of it.
audit.corrected: Changed to eleven seconds, matching rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: A 52.89% win rate was presented under a TRICKY 7/10 label.
audit.why: The content layer, the packet chart and the win rate all agree this is a favourable lane.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED, diffRating 4.5/10, Ryze carry threat held at 7/10 because he does scale.

notes: All seven full-layer sides disagreed with the content layer and the packet chart — the full layer said Skill x5 then Ryze x2 while both other sources said Lissandra on every row. The full layer was moved onto the content values as one atomic group with the whys rewritten, so no win[N] flips were needed. I also moved diff from TRICKY 7/10 to FAVOURED 4.5/10 with tone and the two difficulty summary strings, since a 52.89% win rate and an all-Lissandra chart cannot sit under a 'tricky' label; those enum edits can be dropped independently if the user disagrees. The decisive interaction the page was missing entirely: Rune Prison only roots when Spell Flux is already on you, so Ryze's E is the tell, not his W.
